File Number: D13-056-2026
District: 3 - Collins-Bayridge
Owner: 3039 Princess Street Ltd.
Applicant: The Boulevard Group
The Report of the Commissioner of Growth & Development Services (COA-26-066) is attached.
Recommendation:
That
minor variance application, File Number D13-056-2026, for the property located at 3039 Princess Street to permit a modified building design with an increased building height and elimination of a 1.8 metre deep stepback above the third storey on the front (north) and rear (south) elevation, with the exception of the 1.8 metre deep and 8.4 metre wide stepback in the southeast corner, be approved, as described below:
Variance Number 1: Maximum Height
By-Law Number 2022-62: 21.1.1. E207.(b)
Requirement: The maximum permitted height is 13 metres;
Proposed: The maximum permitted height is 14 metres;
Variance Requested: 1.0 metre
Variance Number 2: Minimum Stepbacks Establishing Terraces
By-Law Number 2022-62:21.1.1. E.207.(c)
Requirement: The minimum stepbacks for the staggered front and rear façade of an apartment building are specified on Figure E207;
Proposed: No stepbacks are required for the staggered front and rear façade, with the exception of the 1.8 metre deep stepback with a width of 8.4 metres on the south east corner of the building, specified on Figure E207;
Variance Requested: Elimination of 1.8 metre deep stepbacks on the staggered front and rear façade with the exception of the south east corner; and
That
approval of the application be subject to the conditions attached as Exhibit A (Recommended Conditions) to Report Number COA-26-066.
